say:1:1330926001:1.text: According to the captain's order, preparations will only begin once the unrest has been quelled.
say:1:1330926001:1.source_cn: 根据侍卫长的命令，要等到公国内的骚乱暂时平息，才会开始筹备。
say:1:1330926001:1.male: According to the captain's order, preparations will only begin once the unrest has been quelled.
say:1:1330926001:1.female: According to the captain's order, preparations will only begin once the unrest has been quelled.

say:2:1330926002:1.text: Until then, the princess will rest in the mortuary, with her beloved sapphirine blossoms by her side...
say:2:1330926002:1.source_cn: 在那之前，公主会暂时在停灵室中与她最爱的蓝绒花为伴……
say:2:1330926002:1.male: Until then, the princess will rest in the mortuary, with her beloved sapphirine blossoms by her side...
say:2:1330926002:1.female: Until then, the princess will rest in the mortuary, with her beloved sapphirine blossoms by her side...

say:3:1330926003:1.text: I believe Captain Rodrigo will take care of everything soon.
say:3:1330926003:1.source_cn: 虽然大公已逝，但以罗德里戈大人的能力，我相信不会让民众...
say:3:1330926003:1.male: I believe Captain Rodrigo will take care of everything soon.
say:3:1330926003:1.female: I believe Captain Rodrigo will take care of everything soon.
